title: Comedy Masters
desc: Talented comedians perform humorous acts and satirical sketches to entertain a special guest and make them burst with laughter.

title: Rudraksham
desc: When Vishwanathan learns that Sudhakar, a gangster's son, raped his sister, he gets enraged and kills the man. To avenge his son's death, the don sends out a manhunt for Vishwanathan.

title: Vakku Maruvakku
desc: The host interviews prominent politicians from different political parties in Kerala about their ideologies and the current situation in the country.

title: Ammayodoppam
desc: Mata Amritanandamayi, a religious leader, delivers discourses and inspires devotees to follow a spiritually balanced and righteous life.

title: Ucha Vartha
desc: The host talks about some of the latest news stories about political, economic, social and cultural topics from all around the region.

title: Moonnam Pakkam
desc: Thampi, a retired old man, leads an isolated life in the village and is excited for his grandson Pachu's return. He welcomes Pachu and his friends, but his happiness is short-lived.

title: Mounam Sammatham
desc: When Sundaram, an innocent man, is accused of murdering his brother's wife, his attorney asks Raja, an eminent lawyer from Delhi, to fight his case.

title: Sandhya Deepam
desc: Religious leaders and scholars deliver a discourse on various aspects of Kerala's rich cultural heritage and spiritual observances.

title: Shikkar
desc: Balaraman, a truck driver, settles down in a mountainous village with his daughter, Ganga. However, his dark past soon confronts him as he tries to protect himself and his kin from dangerous men.
